items.title_cn: 使用金属支架治疗坏死性胰腺液体积聚一例报告
items.title_en: Use of a metallic stent for the treatment of a post-necrotic pancreatic fluid collection. Case report
items.abstract_cn: 目的。评估金属支架置入在胰腺液体积聚治疗中的临床效用。病例报告。我们报告一例51岁复杂性急性胰腺炎患者，采用自膨式金属支架进行胰腺假性囊肿内镜引流的病例。手术时间为30分钟。术中及术后均未发生并发症。支架置入后，反复进行内镜下坏死组织清除术及囊腔冲洗，并清除坏死碎屑。随访影像显示囊腔大小从14.1×9.0×9.0 cm缩小至5.1×3.2×2.1 cm，坏死碎屑完全消退。囊壁显示肉芽组织形成。患者状况良好出院。结论。内镜超声引导下囊肿胃吻合术并置入自膨式金属支架是一种现代、有效且微创的治疗选择，可作为传统手术治疗的替代方案。需要进一步研究以评估该技术的疗效及其长期结局。
items.abstract_en: Objective. To evaluate the clinical utility of metallic stent placement in the management of pancreatic fluid collections. Case report. We report a case of endoscopic drainage of a pancreatic pseudocyst in a 51-year-old patient with complicated acute pancreatitis using a self-expandable metallic stent. The procedure time was 30 minutes. No intraoperative or postoperative complications occurred. Following stent placement, repeated endoscopic necrosectomy and irrigation of the cyst cavity were performed with removal of necrotic debris. Follow-up imaging demonstrated a reduction in the size of the cystic cavity from 14.1×9.0×9.0 cm to 5.1×3.2×2.1 cm, with complete resolution of necrotic debris. The cavity walls showed granulation tissue formation. The patient was discharged in satisfactory condition. Conclusions. Endoscopic ultrasound-guided cystogastrostomy with placement of a self-expandable metallic stent is a modern, effective, and minimally invasive treatment option that may serve as an alternative to conventional surgical management. Further studies are required to evaluate the efficacy of this technique and its long-term outcomes.
items.summary_cn: 该病例报告描述了使用自膨式金属支架进行EUS引导下囊肿胃吻合术，成功治疗一例51岁复杂性急性胰腺炎患者的胰腺假性囊肿，术后囊腔从14.1×9.0×9.0 cm缩小至5.1×3.2×2.1 cm，坏死碎屑完全清除，无术中或术后并发症。作者认为该技术是现代、有效、微创的治疗选择，可作为传统手术的替代方案。

authors: Nazrul Islam, Sharmin Shabnam, Nusrat Khan, Clare Gillies, Francesco Zaccardi, Amitava Banerjee, Vahé Nafilyan, Kamlesh Khunti, Hajira Dambha-Miller, on behalf of the CVD-COVID-UK/COVID-IMPACT Consortium

items.title_cn: SpyGlass辅助诊断弥漫大B细胞淋巴瘤胆道侵犯：一例报告
items.title_en: SpyGlass-assisted diagnosis of biliary tract invasion by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma: a case report
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 背景 胆总管（CBD）弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤（DLBCL）极为罕见，易与胆管癌或胆总管结石相混淆，导致诊断延迟。内镜逆行胰胆管造影术（ERCP）刷检细胞学对不确定性胆道狭窄的敏感性有限。SpyGlass胆道镜可实现直视下靶向活检，在本病例中具有更高的诊断阳性率。本病例阐述了其在诊断胆道淋巴瘤中的作用，并利用基因重排分析评估同步性胃部和胆道病变之间的克隆相关性。病例介绍 一名59岁男性因发热、黄疸和上腹痛就诊。实验室检查证实为梗阻性黄疸和急性胰腺炎。影像学检查显示远端CBD狭窄、肝脏病变及淋巴结肿大。胃镜检查发现胃DLBCL。急诊ERCP并置入胆道支架解除梗阻。SpyGlass胆道镜观察到远端CBD 3/4环周性肿块；靶向活检经组织学和免疫组化证实为DLBCL（CD20+、CD79a+）。患者有未经治疗的十二指肠滤泡性淋巴瘤病史，提示转化。基因重排分析显示胃部和胆道病变具有相同的克隆起源，且胆道病变中存在额外的重排。结论 本病例描述了SpyGlass胆道镜在诊断胆道淋巴瘤中的作用。基因重排分析证实了胃部和胆道病变具有共同的克隆起源，尽管在胆道病变中检测到的额外免疫球蛋白重排意义尚不明确。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Background Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) of the common bile duct (CBD) is exceedingly rare and mimics cholangiocarcinoma or choledocholithiasis, delaying diagnosis. Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) brush cytology offers limited sensitivity for indeterminate biliary strictures. SpyGlass cholangioscopy enables direct visualization and targeted biopsy with higher diagnostic yield in this case. This case illustrates its role in diagnosing biliary lymphoma and uses gene rearrangement analysis to assess clonal relatedness between synchronous gastric and biliary lesions. Case presentation A 59-year-old male presented with fever, jaundice, and epigastric pain. Laboratory tests confirmed obstructive jaundice and acute pancreatitis. Imaging revealed a distal CBD stricture, hepatic lesions, and lymphadenopathy. Gastroscopy identified gastric DLBCL. Emergency ERCP with biliary stenting relieved obstruction. SpyGlass cholangioscopy visualized a 3/4 circumferential distal CBD mass; targeted biopsy confirmed DLBCL (CD20+, CD79a+) on histology and immunohistochemistry. The patient had a history of untreated duodenal follicular lymphoma, suggesting transformation. Gene rearrangement analysis demonstrated identical clonal origin of gastric and biliary lesions, with an additional rearrangement in the biliary lesion. Conclusion This case describes the role of SpyGlass cholangioscopy in diagnosing biliary lymphoma. Gene rearrangement analysis confirmed a shared clonal origin of the gastric and biliary lesions, although an additional immunoglobulin rearrangement detected in the biliary lesion remains of uncertain significance.
items.summary_cn: 本病例报告描述了一例胆总管弥漫大B细胞淋巴瘤，通过SpyGlass胆道镜直视下靶向活检确诊，并利用基因重排分析证实胃与胆道病变具有相同克隆起源，同时胆道病变中检出额外的免疫球蛋白重排。该案例展示了SpyGlass胆道镜在胆道淋巴瘤诊断中的价值，并提示其可用于评估同步多部位病变的克隆相关性。

items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎患者多器官衰竭预测的可解释机器学习模型开发与验证：一项多中心队列研究
items.title_en: Development and validation of an explainable machine learning model for predicting multiple organ failure in patients with acute pancreatitis: a multicenter cohort study
items.abstract_cn: 急性胰腺炎可导致一种严重且危及生命的状况，称为多器官衰竭（MOF）。及时准确地预测和检测MOF至关重要。利用机器学习的预测模型在急诊情况下预测MOF已显示出潜力。然而，专门用于预测急性胰腺炎患者MOF的应用仍不广泛。本研究旨在创建并验证一种基于机器学习的模型，用于预测急性胰腺炎患者的MOF。本研究利用两个回顾性队列来开发、验证和测试该模型。推导队列和验证队列来源于MIMIC-IV数据库，该数据库被随机分为两部分（70%用于模型开发，30%用于内部验证）。对于外部验证，使用了山西医科大学第三医院肝胆胰外科的回顾性队列（DHPS队列）。在进行多种数据预处理技术（包括插值和标准化）后，我们应用了四种特征选择方法，最终确定了15个关键特征。利用七种机器学习算法创建预测模型，并通过多种指标评估其性能，如ROC（受试者工作特征曲线）、DCA（决策曲线分析）、PRC（精确率-召回率曲线）、校准曲线和混淆矩阵。最终模型的解释采用SHAP技术进行，并创建了一个基于网络的风险计算器以供临床使用。最后，将最终模型分别与SOFA评分和APACHE Ⅱ评分进行比较，以确定其临床价值。该模型利用MIMIC-Ⅳ数据库（n=582）的数据创建，并使用MIMIC-Ⅳ（n=250）和山西医科大学第三医院肝胆胰外科（n=474）数据集进行了验证和测试。我们通过四种不同的选择技术和七种机器学习算法确定了最佳特征组合。所有四种选择方法均识别出的一个变量被纳入模型开发过程。最有效的模型CatBoost是使用15个易于获取的入院特征构建的，包括INR（国际标准化比值）、Cr（肌酐）、PO2（氧分压）、Nbps（无创收缩压）、BIL（胆红素）、HTN（高血压）、PH（酸碱度）、LAC（乳酸）、Hb（血红蛋白）、CKD（慢性肾脏病）、T（体温）、ALT（丙氨酸氨基转移酶）、HR（心率）、Na+（钠）、ABX（抗生素）。在验证期间，其AUC值达到0.939，F1分数为0.795，准确率为0.856。随后，通过5折交叉验证和网格搜索对推导队列进行了超参数优化。最终模型在测试数据集上进行了评估，AUC为0.855，F1分数为0.658，准确率为0.761。此外，SHAP分析表明，INR、Cr和PO2是影响模型预测的三个最重要的变量。该模型已被转化为在线临床工具，以增强其在医疗环境中的应用。在验证中，通过ROC和决策曲线分析，CatBoost显示出优于APACHE II（0.802，95%CI：0.747–0.858）和SOFA（0.819，95%CI：0.765–0.874）的区分能力（AUC：0.941，95%CI：0.914–0.968）。具有可解释性的CatBoost模型有效预测了急性胰腺炎患者发生MOF的可能性，在内部和外部验证组中均展现出强大的预测性能。此外，该模型已被实施为在线风险评估工具，以提高其在临床环境中的实际应用。
items.abstract_en: Acute pancreatitis can lead to a serious and life-threatening situation known as multiple organ failure (MOF). Timely and precise forecasting and detection of MOF are essential. Predictive models utilizing machine learning have shown potential in forecasting MOF in emergency situations. Nevertheless, their use for predicting MOF specifically in patients with acute pancreatitis is still not widespread. This research seeks to create and confirm a machine learning-based model for predicting MOF in individuals suffering from acute pancreatitis. This research utilized two retrospective cohorts for the purposes of developing, validating, and testing the model. The derivation and validation cohorts were sourced from the MIMIC-IV database, which was divided randomly into two segments (70% for model development and 30% for internal validation). For external validation, a retrospective cohort from The Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery at the Third Hospital of Shanxi Medical University (DHPS cohort) was used. After performing several data preprocessing techniques, including interpolation and standardization, we applied four methods for feature selection, ultimately identifying 15 key features. Seven machine learning algorithms were utilized to create predictive models, with their performance assessed through various metrics such as ROC (receiver operating characteristic), DCA (decision curve analysis), PRC (precision recall curve), calibration curve, and confusion matrice. The final model's interpretation was carried out using SHAP technology, and a web-based risk calculator was created for use in clinical settings. Finally, the final model was used to compare with the SOFA score and APACHE Ⅱ score, respectively, to determine its clinical value. The model was created utilizing data from the MIMIC-Ⅳ database (n=582) and underwent validation and testing with both the MIMIC-Ⅳ (n=250) and The Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery at the Third Hospital of Shanxi Medical University (n=474) datasets. We identified the best feature combination through four different selection techniques and seven machine learning algorithms. A variable that was recognized by all four selection methods was included in the model development process. The most effective model, CatBoost, was built using 15 easily accessible admission features, including INR (international normalized ratio), Cr (creatinine), PO2 (partial pressure of oxygen), Nbps (non-invasive blood pressure systolic), BIL (bilirubin), HTN (hypertension), PH (potential of hydrogen), LAC (lactate), Hb (hemoglobin), CKD (chronic kidney disease), T (temperature), ALT (alanine aminotransferase), HR (heart rate), Na + (sodion), ABX (antibiotic). During validation, it achieved an AUC value of 0.939, an F1 score of 0.795, and an accuracy rate of 0.856. Subsequently, hyperparameter optimization was conducted on the derivation cohort via 5-fold cross-validation and grid search. The final model was assessed on the test dataset, yielding an AUC of 0.855, an F1 score of 0.658, and an accuracy of 0.761. Additionally, SHAP analysis indicated that INR, Cr, and PO2 are the three most significant variables affecting the model's predictions. This model has been transformed into an online clinical tool to enhance its application in healthcare environments. In validation, CatBoost demonstrated superior discrimination (AUC: 0.941, 95%CI: 0.914–0.968) compared to both APACHE II (0.802, 95%CI: 0.747–0.858) and SOFA (0.819, 95%CI: 0.765–0.874) through ROC and decision curve analyses. The CatBoost model, which is interpretable, effectively forecasted the likelihood of MOF in individuals suffering from acute pancreatitis, showcasing strong predictive performance in both internal and external validation groups. Additionally, this model has been implemented as an online tool for risk assessment to improve its practical application in clinical settings.
items.summary_cn: 该研究开发并验证了一种基于CatBoost的可解释机器学习模型，利用15个入院特征预测急性胰腺炎患者的多器官衰竭，在内部和外部验证中均表现出良好区分度（AUC分别为0.939和0.941），优于APACHE II和SOFA评分，并转化为在线临床工具。SHAP分析显示INR、Cr和PO2是影响预测的最重要变量。

items.title_cn: 术前SGLT2抑制剂使用与2型糖尿病患者ERCP术后不良事件风险：一项现用药者目标试验模拟（SGLT2i-PEP研究）
items.title_en: Pre-Procedural SGLT2 Inhibitor Use and the Risk of Post-ERCP Adverse Events Among Patients With Type 2 Diabetes: A Prevalent-User Target Trial Emulation (The SGLT2i-PEP Study)
items.abstract_cn: ERCP后胰腺炎（PEP）仍然是内镜逆行胰胆管造影术最常见的不良事件，而药物预防在很大程度上仅限于直肠NSAIDs。钠-葡萄糖协同转运蛋白2抑制剂（SGLT2i）具有多效性抗炎作用，包括抑制NLRP3炎症小体和炎症细胞因子信号传导，这些作用在生物学上可能是急性胰腺炎早期炎症级联反应的可调控因素。一项初步的队列水平分析提示SGLT2i使用者的PEP发生率较低，但受限于残余混杂因素。本研究模拟了一项目标试验，其中2018年至2024年间接受ERCP的2型糖尿病成人在手术当日接受长期稳定的SGLT2i治疗对比长期稳定的非SGLT2i糖尿病治疗（二甲双胍、磺脲类药物、DPP-4抑制剂、噻唑烷二酮类药物或胰岛素）。选择现用用户设计是因为临床问题关注的是在ERCP时正在接受治疗而非启动治疗，且宽限期新用户设计容易产生永恒时间偏倚。GLP-1受体激动剂使用者被排除在两组之外。数据来自TriNetX研究网络链接的电子健康记录和索赔数据集，具有个体患者级别的访问权限。主要结局是30天PEP，采用基于索赔的定义进行判定，该定义此前已对照已发表的基准荟萃分析进行校准（OSF DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/JV7QY）。次要结局为ERCP后出血、胆管炎和确诊胆囊炎；PEP严重程度为探索性结局；穿孔和糖尿病酮症酸中毒分别作为阴性和阳性对照结局。心血管和肾脏适应症所致的混杂通过在一套全面的心肾协变量集上进行重叠加权来处理，主要估计目标为30天PEP的重叠加权风险比。预先指定的敏感性分析包括替代暴露和结局定义、限制性对照人群、E值以及阴性对照暴露分析。可行性工作（队列计数、暴露组规模及粗未调整事件率）表明SGLT2i组将达到数百例，因此本研究被定位为效应量及其不确定性的估计，而非验证性检验。注册前未进行任何调整后的结局分析。报告将遵循TARGET指南。
items.abstract_en: Post-ERCP pancreatitis (PEP) remains the most frequent serious adverse event of endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography, and pharmacologic prophylaxis is largely limited to rectal NSAIDs. Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) have pleiotropic anti-inflammatory effects, including suppression of the NLRP3 inflammasome and inflammatory cytokine signaling, that are biologically plausible modifiers of the early inflammatory cascade of acute pancreatitis. A preliminary cohort-level analysis suggested lower PEP incidence among SGLT2i users but was limited by residual confounding. This study emulates a target trial in which adults with type 2 diabetes undergoing ERCP between 2018 and 2024 are on chronic, stable SGLT2i therapy versus chronic, stable non-SGLT2i diabetes therapy (metformin, sulfonylureas, DPP-4 inhibitors, thiazolidinediones, or insulin) on the day of the procedure. A prevalent-user design was chosen because the clinical question concerns being on therapy at the time of ERCP rather than initiating it, and because grace-period new-user designs are prone to immortal time bias. GLP-1 receptor agonist users are excluded from both arms. Data come from the TriNetX Research Network linked electronic health record and claims dataset with individual-patient-level access. The primary outcome is 30-day PEP ascertained with a claims-based definition previously calibrated against a published benchmark meta-analysis (OSF DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/JV7QY). Secondary outcomes are post-ERCP bleeding, cholangitis, and confirmed cholecystitis; PEP severity is exploratory; perforation and diabetic ketoacidosis serve as negative and positive control outcomes. Confounding by cardiovascular and renal indication is addressed with overlap weighting on a comprehensive cardiorenal covariate set, and the primary estimand is the overlap-weighted hazard ratio for 30-day PEP. Pre-specified sensitivity analyses include alternative exposure and outcome definitions, restricted comparators, an E-value, and negative control exposure analyses. Feasibility work (cohort counts, exposure arm sizes, and crude unadjusted event rates) indicates the SGLT2i arm will number in the hundreds, so the study is framed as estimation of the effect size and its uncertainty rather than a confirmatory test. No adjusted outcome analyses were performed before registration. Reporting will follow the TARGET guideline.
items.summary_cn: 该研究采用目标试验模拟方法，评估2型糖尿病患者ERCP术前长期稳定使用SGLT2抑制剂与30天术后胰腺炎（PEP）风险的关系，主要结局为重叠加权风险比；研究定位为效应量及其不确定性的估计而非确证性检验，尚未进行分析前注册。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
